The Spigot/Paper/Bukkit entry point. It starts CraftyTML the way the Fabric client does, running every script in `plugins/CraftyTML/ui` through `CTMLAPI` into the `UIRegistry`, and adds the renderers a server has of its own: `WindowRenderer`, which shows a tree to one player, and `HologramRenderer`, which stands one in the world for everyone. The `/ctml` command lives in `CTMLCommand`.

```java
import net.tutla.craftytml.paper.CraftytmlPaper;
```

## Members

### `public static CTMLWindows windows()`

The windows a `WindowRenderer` opens trees in.

### `public static CTMLHolograms holograms()`

The holograms standing in the world, which a `HologramRenderer` puts trees into.
